preregistration.purpose: Freeze the blinded paired-quality review material, questions, coder process and result fields before any live comparison result.

unit: One matched scenario-and-repetition pair presented as condition A and condition B.

blinding.assignment: Randomly assign MVP and prompt-only outputs to A/B independently for each pair and retain the key separately from coder materials.

criteria.name: Protocol coverage
criteria.prompt: Rate how well the material addresses the information required by the Protocol.

criteria.name: Probing relevance and neutrality
criteria.prompt: Rate whether any probe targets missing information, is concise, and is not leading.
criteria.not_applicable_rule: Use N/A only when neither condition contains a probe for the evaluated material.

criteria.name: Transcript grounding and fidelity
criteria.prompt: Rate whether draft evidence is supported by participant sources and preserves participant meaning.

criteria.name: Participant clarity and control
criteria.prompt: Rate whether questions, Skip, Stop, boundary and missing-information handling are clear to the participant.

criteria.name: Researcher reviewability
criteria.prompt: Rate whether a researcher can understand, inspect and decide Include, Edit or Exclude from the material.
